# Norvia Labs

> Norvia Labs builds tools for putting AI agents to work inside limits you set. Founded in October 2025 by Mohit Ranka. Products: Forge (available) and Conclave (coming soon), on top of a control layer for AI agents that is in development.

Every product keeps agents bounded, keeps people in charge of anything that changes the world, and shows its evidence.

## Products

- [Forge](https://norvialabs.com/products/forge/): Open-source terminal coding environment where AI agents run inside an OS sandbox (Seatbelt on macOS, bubblewrap on Linux). Rust, MIT, pre-release v0.1.0-beta.11 (28 Sep 2026). [source](https://github.com/norvialabs/forge) · [releases](https://github.com/norvialabs/forge/releases)
- [Conclave](https://norvialabs.com/conclave/): Teams of AI agents and people with limits built in: bounded runs, budgeted delegation, approvers for anything that changes the world, and Studio, a no-code builder. Coming soon; not yet publicly released.

## People
